channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Esker Candidates in Mamers Valles
item.description: An esker is a long ridge of sediment deposited by meltwater from a retreating glacier or ice sheet. Although glaciers are common on Mars, in the prevailing very cold and dry climate they are thought to be almost exclusively cold-based systems, which do not experience subglacial melt. These candidate eskers could be important to our understanding of non-climatic drivers of meltwater production and, potentially, habitability. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
